purpose.zh: 分腿坐，练大腿前面把伸直的腿抬起来
purpose.en: Sitting in a straddle, builds the front of your thigh to lift a straight leg.

text.zh: 腿伸直，一条腿抬离地面
text.en: Leg straight, lift it off the floor

text.zh: 分腿坐直，指尖在要抬那条腿两边点地。
text.en: Sit tall in a wide straddle, fingertips on the floor either side of the lifting leg.

text.zh: 腿放下停稳，手抬起转到另一边再撑地。
text.en: Once the leg is down, lift your hands, turn to the other side and place them again.

text.zh: 左腿抬一次、右腿抬一次，合起来记 1 下。
text.en: One lift with each leg makes one.

commonErrors.en: Falling back as the leg lifts.

cautions.zh: 大腿前面抽筋或胯疼就停下歇会儿
cautions.en: Stop and rest if the front of your thigh cramps or your hip hurts.

changes: 动画左右轮流（先左腿，每次之间手转到另一边约 1.8 s）→ unilateral=true、startingSide left、rep_alternate、剂量每侧 4 次
节奏按 spec：抬 0.3 s + 顶端停 0.3 s 合成 go 0.6 s / 放下 0.5 s / 休+换边 2.9 s
